verdict.rationale: Bench holds sensitive financial data and uses AI features such as the AI Categorization Assistant, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training policy, a data-usage exclusion, or a user control to opt out. The security page covers only Plaid account connections, which says nothing about whether customer data is used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
